Bhide realizes he fell victim to an email lottery scam promising a ₹1 crore jackpot. Having already deposited ₹1.5 lakh into the fraudsters' accounts by mortgaging Madhavi's jewelry at RBC Securities, he breaks the news to Madhavi when the scammers demand another ₹75,000.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
